title: Allow planned scenario verification before implementation
outOfScope: Treating a human decision as a generic bypass for missing intent, scope, unknowns, acceptance, sources, capability, or verification
Allowing ai-finish or Scenario Coverage Guard to accept required unverified scenarios
Changing the enforced Preflight policy to advisory or removing blocked statuses
Implementing the paused deep-performance optimization in this corrective Work Item
Publishing a release or changing release identity

sources.reason: Current Scenario Coverage signal maps every required unverified scenario to Partial and therefore blocks implementation.
Finish-time guard independently requires verified evidence or an explicit risk path; it must remain fail closed.
Existing regressions prove missing evidence blocks, matching Decision Evidence remains paused, and fully verified Contracts are ready.
Existing lifecycle tests cover status refresh and ai-start rollback boundaries.
RFE-ISSUE-052, RFE-ISSUE-065, and RFE-ISSUE-111 document the repeated dead-end transition and user-authorized corrective order.

riskAssessment.reason: A permissive Preflight transition could become a governance bypass, while non-atomic ai-start failure can dirty authoritative status before a Work Item exists.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized fixing discovered process defects before resuming the performance Work Item and instructed continuous execution without another confirmation.

preReviewWarnings: Review that planned verification cannot mask missing or ambiguous Contract evidence.
Review that finish-time required scenario evidence remains unchanged and fail closed.
Review ai-start rollback so a rejected start leaves status bytes unchanged.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A medium/high-risk code Contract whose required unverified scenarios each declare non-empty expected and verificationPlan fields derives Scenario Coverage=Ready for implementation planning, with evidence explicitly stating that verification is planned rather than complete.
A required unverified scenario missing expected or verificationPlan remains Partial and causes enforced Preflight to return needs_human_confirmation.

Missing intent, unknown review, scope, outOfScope, sources, acceptance, verification, capability, or blocked execution decisions continue to produce needs_human_confirmation or not_ready; Decision Evidence does not override them.
The finish-time Scenario Coverage Guard still returns an error for required unverified Summary scenarios, including scenarios that had a Contract verificationPlan.
A failed ai-start lifecycle preflight restores current_status.md byte-for-byte and leaves no active Contract, Summary, start receipt, or Decision Evidence.
English and Japanese runtime guidance and canonical glossaries distinguish implementation-readiness planning from verified completion evidence.
RFE-ISSUE-052, RFE-ISSUE-065, RFE-ISSUE-111, and the newly observed ai-start atomicity issue are mapped to executable tests and the comprehensive plan.

The corrective completes Contract→preflight/checkpoint→TDD implementation→quality→Summary/archive→PR/Hosted CI→merge→ai-close→branch cleanup→main synchronization before the performance Work Item resumes.
guidelines: Evidence over Self-Declaration remains the controlling principle.
Planned verification is permission to implement, never evidence that implementation passed.
A failed lifecycle command must not leave tracked governance state changed.
Prefer a narrow state derivation over policy weakening or human-approval bypass.

intent.problem: The enforced Preflight has no legal transition for medium/high-risk code Work Items whose required scenarios can only be verified after implementation: unverified scenarios force needs_human_confirmation, matching human Decision Evidence becomes human_decision_recorded and remains blocked, and marking scenarios verified before implementation would misstate evidence. During reproduction, ai-start also rewrote no-active current_status before rejecting a dirty lifecycle state.
constraints: Do not weaken the enforced Preflight policy or treat human approval as a generic bypass.
Require explicit expected and verificationPlan fields for every required unverified scenario admitted to implementation.
Keep Summary Scenario Coverage and ai-finish fail closed until actual evidence verifies each required scenario.
Make failed ai-start operations atomic with respect to tracked status and generated Work Item artifacts.
Do not modify performance implementation or release state in this corrective.
intent.rationale: Separating implementation readiness from completion evidence removes the repeated deadlock while preserving the Trust Layer boundary: a concrete test plan may authorize coding, but only executed evidence may authorize finish and merge.

rawUserRequest: 每个工单执行时如果发现流程问题先记录并修复流程，再继续原工单；计划完成后统一确认是否改善。当前发现 Preflight 对实现后才能验证的 required scenarios 没有合法 ready 转移，必须先完成独立 corrective 的完整 PR、合并、关闭和分支清理流程。

declaredIntent.summary: Create a fail-closed implementation-ready transition for concrete planned scenario verification and make rejected ai-start operations atomic.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Missing or ambiguous Contract evidence does not become implementation-ready.
Matching human Decision Evidence remains bound to the current Contract and does not turn a non-ready Contract into ready.
A fully evidenced Contract with verified required scenarios derives ready.
